summary: Completed testing of Yodeck slide theme customization and download functionality. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified theme panel, preset selection, color pickers, and download functionality all working correctly.

minor.issue: Existing Q1 2026 settings don't have slide_theme fields stored in DB (created before feature was added). The yodeck endpoints use default 'dark_navy' theme which is correct behavior.

design_issues.screen: Settings page - Yodeck Slide Theme section
issues: Theme preset buttons are disabled when quarter is locked - this is expected behavior but user cannot preview themes on locked quarters

passed_tests: GET /api/v2/yodeck/{year}/{quarter}/all - slides have correct fields (id, name, endpoint, pages, category)
GET /api/v2/yodeck/{year}/{quarter}/all - tier counts match total employees
Slide has Content-Disposition header for download
Frontend: Yodeck page loads with Theme button visible
Frontend: Theme panel opens with 4 preset themes
Frontend: Theme presets clickable and update color values
Frontend: Download button shows 'Slide downloaded!' toast
Frontend: Download All button shows 'Downloading all slides...' toast
Frontend: Current theme displayed correctly ('Dark Navy')
Frontend: Settings page has Yodeck Slide Theme section
Frontend: Settings page shows Live Preview of theme
seed_data_creation: Using existing Q1 2026 data with 28 employees (10 A-Servers, 9 B-Servers, 9 C-Servers)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Yodeck theme customization feature fully tested. Theme presets (Dark Navy, Light Corporate, Bubba Red, Ocean Blue) work correctly on /yodeck page. Custom color pickers available. Download functionality working - both individual slides and Download All. Note: Q1 2026 is locked so theme settings cannot be saved, but the UI correctly shows disabled state. The slide_theme fields were added after Q1 2026 settings were created, so they use default values.
